description: This file contains the implementation of Bootstrap's tooltip component version 3.3.7, including the Tooltip class, its methods, and plugin definition.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Class implementing Bootstrap's tooltip functionality, managing tooltip creation, positioning, showing, hiding, and destruction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Tooltip instance with element and options, sets up event triggers.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns default configuration options for the tooltip.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges user options with defaults and data attributes.

methods.name: getDelegateOptions
methods.description: Returns options for delegated tooltip instances.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focusin events to show the tooltip.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or focusout events to hide the tooltip.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip with positioning and transition effects.

methods.name: applyPlacement
methods.description: Positions the tooltip element based on calculated offsets and placement.

methods.name: replaceArrow
methods.description: Adjusts the position of the tooltip arrow.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the tooltip based on title.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and detaches the tooltip element.

methods.name: fixTitle
methods.description: Removes the title attribute and stores it in data-original-title.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the tooltip has content to display.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the element for tooltip placement.

methods.name: getCalculatedOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for tooltip placement based on position and placement.

methods.name: getViewportAdjustedDelta
methods.description: Adjusts tooltip position to stay within viewport boundaries.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip title from element attributes or options.

methods.name: getUID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for tooltip elements.

methods.name: tip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip DOM element, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: arrow
methods.description: Returns the arrow element within the tooltip.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the tooltip.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the tooltip.

methods.name: toggleEnabled
methods.description: Toggles tooltip enabled state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles tooltip visibility based on events.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the tooltip instance and cleans up.
